name: PT Victoria Care Indonesia Tbk
summary: PT Victoria Care Indonesia Tbk manufactures and sells cosmetics and toiletries in Indonesia and internationally. It operates in three segments: Personal Care and Antiseptic, Hair Care, and Others. The Personal Care and Antiseptic segment offers skincare creams and lotions, makeup, and body care products, such as body scrubs, hand and body soaps, perfumes, and deodorants; and antiseptic products, including antiseptic liquids and gels, antiseptic soaps, cleaning fluids, disinfectant liquids and sprays, and other products. It also provides facial masks, facial cotton, eyebrow pencils, lip creams, serums, hand sanitizers, and mouthwash. The Hair Care segment offers shampoo, hair mask, hair color…
